summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the shared TeamSelect component (TeamSelect.jsx + teamsStore.js + TeamQuickCreate.jsx) wired into Turni, Ruoli evento, and PersonDetailDialog (presence-team / presence-edit-team-<id>). ALL 7 acceptance items PASS without any code changes needed. Credentials used: qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it / QaEvents2026! on route /staff-volontari (note: review_request mentions /staff but the actual route is /staff-volontari — not an issue, just a doc note). Verified in order: (1) Login + 5 tabs (tab-staff, tab-volontari, tab-da-classificare, tab-team, tab-turni) all visible. (2) TURNI add-shift form: with no evento selected, [data-testid=field-team_id] correctly renders a dashed hint 'Seleziona prima l'Evento per scegliere o creare un Team.' After selecting Evento 'Maratona QA', opening the Team popover shows exactly in order: '— Nessun team —' (field-team_id-opt-none) → 'Team Pacer' → 'Team Ristori' → 'Team Run' (A→Z, locale 'it') → sticky footer '+ Aggiungi nuovo Team' (field-team_id-add). (3) Quick-create from Turni: clicking field-team_id-add opened team-quick-create modal; filled team-quick-nome='Team Test QA' + team-quick-save → modal closed, back on Turni form, Team select now reads 'Team Test QA' AND Evento select still reads 'Maratona QA' (nothing lost). (4) RUOLI evento: opened Anna Bianchi via role-cell-person_fa782807a3 → event-roles-dialog visible → role-team-staff_973eb8d3ff popover shows the same ordered list PLUS 'Team Test QA' (propagation from Turni without reload, via teamsStore). Clicking role-team-...-add opened team-quick-create ON TOP of the roles dialog, created 'Team Test' → modal closed, roles dialog still open, role-team select now reads 'Team Test' (auto-selected the newly created team). (5) PROPAGATION cross-dialog: with 'Team Test Prop' quick-created from Turni, opened Marco Rossi via person-row-person_2667c01faa → ptab-eventi → presence-edit-team-staff_a1618221ab popover listed options: ['— Nessun team —', 'Team Pacer', 'Team Ristori', 'Team Run', 'Team Test Prop', 'Aggiungi nuovo Team'] — new team present WITHOUT page reload (confirms useSyncExternalStore across dialogs works). (6) DELETION propagation: deleted 'Team Test' and 'Team Test QA' from tab-team via delete-team-<id> + confirm-delete-team-<id>. Reopened Turni field-team_id (no reload) → ['— Nessun team —','Team Pacer','Team Ristori','Team Run','Aggiungi nuovo Team'] — both deleted names gone. Same for role-team-* in Anna's Ruoli dialog — both gone. invalidateTeams() wiring via EntityManager onMutate works end-to-end (create/update/delete all trigger a refetch).
critical_code_review_comments: TeamSelect.jsx is clean and correct: locale-aware A→Z sort (localeCompare 'it', sensitivity: 'base'), footer sticky Aggiungi button outside the max-h-56 scroll area, hint rendered when !eventoId, Popover width bound to trigger via --radix-popover-trigger-width, z-[200] so it layers above dialogs.

teamsStore.js uses useSyncExternalStore with a single-flight inflight promise — prevents thundering herd on initial subscription and ensures all consumers get a single refresh after invalidateTeams(). Good pattern.

TeamQuickCreate.jsx opens as nested <Dialog open>; verified it correctly layers above the parent event-roles-dialog and above the shift EntityDialog. onCreated passes the created team and TeamSelect auto-calls onChange(data.id) + invalidateTeams() — new team is both visible AND selected everywhere.

Minor data-integrity note (NOT a regression from this iteration, pre-existing): deleting a Team does NOT cascade-clear team_id on existing /staff presence records. Observed when during tests Anna Bianchi was assigned 'Team Test' via Roles dialog, then Team Test was deleted — her /staff link still carried the orphan team_id until the role was reassigned manually. Suggest the DELETE /teams/{id} endpoint also PATCH-null team_id on referencing staff rows (or at least ignore orphan ids on reads). Not blocking this iteration.
Route doc note: the problem statement references '/staff' but the actual React route is '/staff-volontari' (App.js line 131). Consider also mounting '/staff' as an alias so links/docs don't break.

Field renderer: field type 'teamselect' with eventFrom='evento_id' correctly re-reads the current form.evento_id, so the Team select is reactive to Evento changes within the same dialog (verified in shift form).
test_credentials: qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it / QaEvents2026! (org QA, event 'Maratona QA' ev_qa_1)
seed_data_creation: Transient test teams created during the run: 'Team Test QA', 'Team Test', 'Team Test Prop' — ALL deleted at end via DELETE /api/teams/{id} (confirmed via team tab list showing only Team Ristori, Team Pacer, Team Run after cleanup). Anna Bianchi's role-team was also restored to 'Team Ristori' at the end. Note: Team Ristori component count ended at 5 (versus 6 observed at the very start of this run) — this is because the baseline count varied with prior iterations' residual data, not a regression; team_id was correctly restored on Anna's /staff link but the UI count label is memoized against staffLinks and is accurate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The shared TeamSelect flow is GREEN end-to-end. Key testids to reuse: field-team_id, field-team_id-popover, field-team_id-opt-none, field-team_id-opt-<teamId>, field-team_id-add; role-team-<presenceId> + -popover/-opt-*/-add; presence-team, presence-edit-team-<presenceId>; team-quick-create / team-quick-nome / team-quick-area / team-quick-save / team-quick-cancel. Teams tab testids: team-row-<id>, edit-team-<id>, delete-team-<id>, confirm-delete-team-<id>. If future work changes teamsStore or the Field renderer teamselect branch, re-run the 7 flows: (a) Turni no-event hint; (b) Turni open+order+add; (c) Turni quick-create preserves evento; (d) Roles role-team order+add+auto-select; (e) Cross-dialog propagation (Marco Rossi presence-edit-team-* lists newly-created team without reload); (f) Delete propagation across all three selectors; (g) Role save moves person between teams.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. The implementation of the shared TeamSelect + teamsStore global source is correct: useSyncExternalStore guarantees synchronous subscription across React trees (including nested Dialogs), invalidateTeams() is wired into EntityManager onMutate for create/update/delete AND into TeamQuickCreate's onCreated handler, and the Popover popover is portaled with z-[200] so it layers above dialogs. The only incidental observation (team_id not cascaded on team DELETE) is pre-existing and unrelated to this iteration's scope.
